text:
sam: Quick sync on the billing UI iteration I uploaded. Trying a compact grid instead of large spend cards so users can compare projects and cost categories at-a-glance. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/cost-grid-v2

riley: Skimmed it. Compact grid looks promising. question: how do we surface invoice history? it's important for finance folks to find month-end invoices quickly.

sam: Thinking: persistent "Invoices" pill in the top filter bar that opens a panel with grouped months and a search. also add per-row quick actions for CSV/PDF export.

joel: Per-row quick actions are handy but they clutter the grid. What if quick actions are hidden behind a row hover menu on desktop and behind a kebab in the expanded row on mobile?

maya: Accessibility: hover-only controls are problematic for keyboard users. If we hide actions on hover, we must also provide a persistent focus target or a keyboard-only affordance. e.g., show a small trailing button that is always in DOM but visually subtle.

max: For the cost cells, do we show $ + % stacked or two distinct columns? Stacked saves width but some PMs prefer separate columns for sorting.

sam: Proposal: stacked by default, with a column toggle to split into separate columns for power users. sorting will follow the selected layout.

riley: UX nit: legends currently use small swatches; on small screens the swatches disappear. prefer inline abbreviated labels like "Gen tok" / "Emb tok" with a tooltip expanding to full name.

maya: Also a11y color note: the gradient used for "compute" vs "storage" is low contrast on dark mode. I'll add a dark-mode-safe palette and a high-contrast toggle. Example CSS for focus ring:

```css
.grid-cell:focus {
  outline: 3px solid #0a84ff; /* WCAG compliant */
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```

max: Invoice exports: finance asked for grouped ZIPs containing CSVs per project + a master summary XLSX. support both CSV and XLSX. also add incremental export (only changed invoices since last export) for large orgs.

joel: Backend note: incremental exports need a stable export cursor. We'll add export_id + last_exported_at in the export job metadata. front-end should show job status + download links.

billing-bot: New export job queued: export-20260301-77 for org:acme-corp (ETA ~2m).

riley: For org vs project toggle, let's avoid hiding project-level filters when in org mode. Finance sometimes filters org-level but then needs to drill to a specific project quickly. Keep project filter visible but secondary (lighter weight).

maya: Keyboard nav for the grid: arrow keys move between cells, Enter opens expanded details, Space toggles row select. Provide aria-live=\"polite\".

sam: Great. About token naming — last usability tests showed confusion. we'll rename labels to be explicit: "Generation tokens (prompt + completion)", "Embedding tokens (input)". Also add a short microcopy line under the legend.

max: Chart interaction: when user clicks a cost cell, show a mini-breakdown popup with sparkline, 7d avg, and top 3 endpoints contributing to cost. allows quick troubleshooting without navigating away.

joel: For mobile, grid collapses to a list. Each list item shows summary row, tap to expand details including invoice button, quick actions, and mini-chart. keep interactions large enough for thumbs.

riley: One more accessibility edge: color-only legends. we need icons or patterns for color-blind users. small dot + pattern combo works well.

maya: I'll propose pattern overlays and update the tokens palette. Also will run the new palette through Lighthouse and axe.

sam: Action items: joel -> prototype hover/menu keyboard parity; maya -> color palette + a11y audit; max -> draft export formats and backend contract; riley -> microcopy for tokens and legend. We'll reconvene Friday for a quick review.

billing-bot: Preview build: https://console.redwood.ai/preview/billing-grid/17710  snapshot expires in 48h

sam: Thanks team :thumbsup:
